topics.title: Game Show & Prize Giveaway
topics.summary: The broadcast features a game show where callers attempt to win prizes like jewelry, appliances, and cash. Participants answer questions while attempting to ‘make a deal’ with the host, Monty Hall; multiple levels of gameplay offer increasing prize values but also increased risk. The program includes segments discussing charitable donations and various individuals involved.”} <start_of_image> deserves more than one chance at winning.

topics.title: Kathy Lee’s Tax Troubles & Musical Criticism
topics.summary: During a radio segment, Kathy Lee expresses embarrassment over being asked to endorse a controversial musical with questionable casting choices and minimal dialogue. She also complains about rising taxes and a recent mafia hit, reflecting on the instability of her personal life.

topics.title: Merv Griffin, Herpes & Palm Beach Intrigue
topics.summary: A man claims his lover is Merv Griffin and provides a subpoena. Discussions shift to alleged sexual activity between Merv and Ava Gabor, Henry Kissinger's involvement, and William Smith’s herpes incident at the Palm Beach Polo Club & Country Club, alongside legal issues surrounding the case.

topics.title: College Student Lawsuit Settlement
topics.summary: A college student sued a school after being referred by a doctor for treatment; the case settled out of court with the school admitting responsibility and sealing records. The settlement amount was $1.05 million, initially sought at $4.5 million due to the doctor's role, but the hosts expressed frustration over lawsuits and suggested alternative legal avenues.

topics.title: Phone Calls & South Africa
topics.summary: During an on-air conversation, Howard takes messages and discusses recent events in South Africa where the government forcibly removed black residents to create an all-white community. He also makes personal comments about his wife’s opinion of racial mixing and engages in a lengthy discussion regarding Penn's dating life including phone calls with him.

topics.title: Willie Shoemaker and a Butt Pirate
topics.summary: Radio hosts discuss Willie Shoemaker’s bizarre driving incident involving a Tonka toy truck, discussing potential causes like lung cancer and the possibility of him being accused of being a ‘butt pirate.’ They also debate Geraldo's new paper venture and explore advertising opportunities.
